title: santifer/career-ops
claim: santifer/career-ops — Open-source AI job search: scan job portals, evaluate listings with a structured A-F rubric into a 1.0-5.0 score, tailor
why_good: Turns job hunting into a structured A–F rubric score per listing — more rigorous than keyword matching, for a painful high-volume task.
value: Job seekers in one national market paying for a month of clarity — which 30 of 900 postings deserve their evening — rather than for volume.
risk: LinkedIn ships a free fit score; churn-on-success caps lifetime value no matter how good the product is.

zh.claim: santifer/career-ops —— 开源 AI 求职:扫招聘网站,用结构化 A–F 评分体系把岗位打成 1.0–5.0 分。
zh.why_good: 把找工作变成对每个岗位的结构化 A–F 打分——比关键词匹配更严谨,面向一个痛苦、高频的任务。
zh.value: 单一市场的求职者，为「一个月的清醒」付费——900 个岗位里哪 30 个值得投——而不是为投递量付费。
zh.risk: LinkedIn 免费上线匹配分；「一成功就流失」封死了客户终身价值。
zh.hook: 把简历一份份投进 ATS 黑洞的人——已经有 12,300 人 fork 回去跑自己的版本、197 人在给它提交代码——依然分不清今晚这 900 个岗位里哪一个值得花一小时。
zh.does: 开源求职系统：扫描各招聘平台，用结构化 A–F 评分体系把每个岗位折算成 1.0–5.0 的匹配分，再定制简历与求职信并跟踪投递漏斗。Node/CLI，自带模型 key，README 有 17 种语言。
zh.gap: 只有极客用得了：要 clone 仓库、配置、在终端里用自己的 API key 驱动——而最需要它的人上周刚被裁，从没打开过终端。
zh.counter: 客户一成功就消失——求职是消费软件里留存最差的品类；LinkedIn 和 Indeed 免费给匹配分，还带着你买不到的分发；Simplify、Teal 和一堆自动投递工具早就在卖付费版。更糟的是，ATS 厂商正在专门识别这类批量定制文本，你的招牌功能站在军备竞赛输的一侧。
zh.differentiator: 卖判断，不卖广撒网：面向单一本土市场做一个不用终端的托管版「我到底该不该投、为什么不该」评分器（中文：BOSS直聘 / 猎聘，这里根本没有诚实的匹配分），按「一次求职周期」收费——这样也不会被 ATS 反垃圾系统盯上。
zh.consumer_angle: 它本来就是面向普通人的，缺口全在于它以开发者仓库的形态交付，而不是产品。

hook: People grinding out applications into ATS black holes — 12,300 of them have forked this to run their own copy, and 197 are patching it — still cannot tell which of tonight's 900 postings is worth an hour.
pick_reason: The project is a tool for job searching but lacks a clear monetizable product and is essentially a collection of features without a unique value proposition.
does: An open-source job-search system: it scans job portals, grades every listing against a structured A–F rubric into a 1.0–5.0 fit score, then tailors the CV and cover letter and tracks the funnel. Node/CLI, bring your own model key, READMEs in 17 languages.
gap: Only geeks can use it: it is a repo you clone, configure and drive from a terminal with your own API key — and the person who needs it most was laid off last week and has never opened one.
counter: The customer disappears by succeeding — job search has the worst retention curve in consumer software — while LinkedIn and Indeed give away a match score with distribution you cannot buy, and Simplify, Teal and a dozen auto-appliers already sell the paid version. Worse, ATS vendors are building detectors for exactly this kind of mass-tailored output, so the headline feature is on the losing side of an arms race.
differentiator: Sell the decision, not the spray: a hosted, no-terminal 'should I even apply, and why not' scorer for one national market (中文: BOSS直聘 / 猎聘, where an honest fit score does not exist), priced per active search — which keeps you off the ATS spam filter's target list.
consumer_angle: It is already aimed at ordinary people; the whole gap is that it ships as a developer repo instead of a product.
